question: Has gateway v2026.7.1 passed the Windows Hub acceptance bar to become the new last-known-good setup version?
rationale: Exact publication is now sufficiently supported, but designating a gateway release as last-known-good requires real Windows setup evidence and release-owner acceptance that automated source review cannot supply.

options.title: Accept after setup proof
options.body: Run the current-head Windows easy-setup path and merge if installation, startup, gateway health, and required repository validation succeed.

options.title: Keep the prior LKG
options.body: Leave 2026.6.11 pinned until v2026.7.1 completes the Windows acceptance run.

recommendation.title: Accept after setup proof
recommendation.body: Run the current-head Windows easy-setup path and merge if installation, startup, gateway health, and required repository validation succeed.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied routing signal and related release-validation history make him the strongest available owner for the release-acceptance choice.
